method.label: Bound the length using an integer product

annotationRationale: The arithmetic-series formula turns the condition into an integer product. Positivity and integrality bound the length, and an explicit sequence attains the bound.
sourceMethod: Follows the official second solution using the arithmetic-series sum and integer factor bound, then verifies the official 90-term example with the same sum formula.

review.mathCheck: The equation \(n(2a+n-1)=90\) makes the second factor a positive integer, so \(n\le90\). The 90 integers from \(-44\) through \(45\) sum to 45, establishing the maximum and choice D.
